versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **party-provisioner**.
- Calculates exact quantities of drinks, ice, food, glassware, and supplies for parties/events based on guest count, duration, guest mix, and weather.
- Uses bartender-standard "drinks per guest-hour" and caterer food planning rules.
- Automatically splits beer/wine/spirits by drinker preference; includes non-alcoholic drink estimates.
- Produces actionable shopping lists rounded to real-world purchase units.
- Useful for any party, BBQ, wedding, or holiday gathering.
